subject: Availability rider & order-form exhibit — draft language and implementation calendar
messages:
From: Rachel Soto <rachel.soto@mednovation.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evan Brooks <evan.brooks@mednovation.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Availability rider request for enterprise MSA

Hi Priya,

Thanks for the quick demo last week. Procurement at Mednovation asked me to confirm whether Redwood can (a) provide a bespoke availability/uptime rider attached to our MSA that reflects phased rollout performance targets, and (b) include specific order-form language for throughput tiers and regional failover.

Key asks from our side:
- A clear uptime target for production traffic (region US-West) with credit schedule tied to 99.9/99.5 bands.
- A defined latency SLA for P95 generation at 2s for short chat prompts and an exception carve-out during controlled model upgrades.
- Evidence that operational telemetry (token-level latency, per-route error rates) will be accessible to our SREs via the Console for 90 days.
- A simple implementation calendar showing canary -> staged -> full prod over a 6-week window.

Can you share draft language for the rider/exhibit and a suggested timeline? Our legal/procurement team would like to review redlines by next Tuesday (26 Jul).

Appreciate it —
Rachel
Rachel Soto
Senior Procurement Manager, Mednovation
Attachments: procurement-reqs-2027-07.pdf (pdf)

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Soto <rachel.soto@mednovation.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Availability rider request for enterprise MSA

Hi Rachel —

Thanks for the clear checklist. We're happy to support a bespoke rider + order-form exhibit that maps to your phased rollout. Next steps from our side: I’ve looped in Karthik (Product/SLAs) and Monica (Solution Ops) to draft proposed exhibit language and an implementation calendar. Laura from Legal will review any MSA redlines.

Quick clarifications before we draft:
- For the latency SLA you mention P95 at 2s — is that for the seeded set of production services (chat-frontend short prompts only) or for all token generation across embeddings/generation?
- Do you expect telemetry access via API keys (read-only) tied to a Mednovation service account, or will SRE access be through a shared Console view + SAML?

If you confirm those two items today, we can circulate a first-pass rider and order-form exhibit by EOD Tuesday (20 Jul) and a coordinated redline to your legal by Monday (25 Jul). Will that timeline work for procurement?

Regards,
Priya Natarajan
Enterprise Account Lead — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
Attachments: none

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rachel Soto <rachel.soto@mednovation.com>, Evan Brooks <evan.brooks@mednovation.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 14:18:00 -0700
Subject: Proposed availability rider + order-form exhibit (first pass)

Hi all —

Attached is a first-pass draft: "availability-rider-exhibit-draft.docx" and a short order-form worksheet "orderform-exhibit-pricing-and-uptime.xlsx" that ties throughput tiers to regional failover commitments. High-level bullets from our draft:

- Availability targets: 99.95% Uptime (Full Production, US-West), 99.9% (Staged), with a credit ladder: 0.5% credit at 99.9–99.95, 1% credit at 99.5–99.9, prorated thereafter.
- Latency commitment: P95 generation <= 2.0s for short chat prompts under the Standard throughput tier (<= 100 reqs/s). Measured at the Console ingress point; controlled upgrade windows (scheduled maintenance) are excluded with 72h notification.
- Exception language: During canary/staged rollout (first 3 weeks) we propose a tolerance band where credits are capped and incident remediation SLAs prioritize recovery and rollback vs. credits. This avoids automatic credit triggers during the controlled ramp.
- Telemetry: Read-only telemetry via SAML-backed Console view for your SREs retained for 90 days + a weekly CSV export link. For API access we propose issuing a dedicated read-only API key to your security contact.

Operational asks for Mednovation:
- Confirm the list of production routes that fall under "short chat prompts" (suggested default: /v1/chat/generate, /v1/generate)
- Identify the SAML admin and the email for the read-only API key request.

Implementation calendar (draft):
- Week 0 (prep): legal sign-off on rider + order-form, exchange of telemetry access details.
- Week 1 (canary): 5% traffic for 48–72h, telemetry checks and rollback criteria validated.
- Week 2–3 (staged): 25–50% traffic, fine-tune batching/quantization profiles for cost/latency.
- Week 4–6 (full prod): 100% traffic ramp with post-mortem window and SLA observability handoff.

Next steps: Laura, please flag any legal language you want tightened; Monica, can you confirm the telemetry export cadence and who will own the CSV job; Priya/Rachel — if the timeline looks OK, we’ll prepare redlines for your legal by 25 Jul so procurement can circulate.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Product — Reliability & SLAs
Redwood Inference
Attachments: availability-rider-exhibit-draft.docx, orderform-exhibit-pricing-and-uptime.xlsx

From: Rachel Soto <rachel.soto@mednovation.com>

Cc: Evan Brooks <evan.brooks@mednovation.com>, procurement@mednovation.com
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2027 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Availability rider & order-form exhibit — draft language and implementation calendar

Hi Priya / Karthik —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the draft language. A few quick notes from procurement and SRE after internal review:

- The uptime ladder looks fine; procurement asks that credits be based on monthly measured availability, not per-incident. Please make that explicit.
- SRE would like the P95 latency measurement point clarified — can we add a sentence that measurements are from edge ingress (closest public endpoint) to response completion, excluding client-side rendering?
- For telemetry access, we prefer the SAML-backed Console view + read-only API key for exports. Evan (cc'ed) will be the SAML admin contact.

If you can incorporate those three small edits and provide a DocuSign-ready redline PDF, we can have legal circulate for signature and aim to execute the rider in the week of 1 Aug. Also please include an explicit clause about how scheduled model upgrades are communicated (72h notice) and that planned upgrades during staged rollout require separate coordination.

Appreciate the detail — we’re aligned on the calendar. Please send the amended rider and a DocuSign link when ready.

Best,
Rachel
Rachel Soto
Senior Procurement Manager, Mednovation
